note: Contract templates, second set (S3.5, D-119). The format is described at the top of src/sim/contracts.js and in first-three.json. With the first three this makes ten: four smuggling, three courier, three salvage. The board offers one of each type, picked by the run's seed.

items.title: The bones of a saint
items.contact: A brother of the Quiet Order, by hand-written letter
items.text: Three reliquary cases the Receivers listed as company property and mean to auction. The Order wants them home. Do not open them; the brother was very clear.
items.note: Margo notes the cases are cold to the touch and draw no power. She notes it twice.

cargo.label: Manifest 0077 · Ecclesiastical furniture
cargo.contents: A narrow box of dark wood lined with grey felt. Inside, wrapped in written cloth, something light that rattles when the box is tilted.

items.title: The union's second set of books
items.contact: Hal Dorn, treasurer, Pell Station local
items.text: Two crates of assay samples, and under the samples two strongboxes of union ledgers the Receivers would very much like to read. Four crates in all; only two are trouble.
items.note: Clean manifest on top. The treasurer shook hands twice, which is once more than people usually do.

cargo.label: Manifest 1188 · Assay samples
cargo.contents: Ore cores in labelled sleeves, exactly as stated.

cargo.label: Manifest 1188 · Assay samples (heavy)
cargo.contents: Under a layer of ore cores, a strongbox of ledgers in a careful hand: every share the union has paid since the company fell, and to whom.

items.title: Unlicensed stock for a free clinic
items.contact: Doctor Imre, who runs a clinic the Cooperative does not know about
items.text: Six crates of medicine with the Cooperative's labels scraped off, for a clinic that treats people who cannot pay. Everybody you could be caught by thinks this is a crime.
items.note: The doctor paid the advance in small, mismatched notes.

cargo.label: Manifest 2302 · Industrial solvent
cargo.contents: Antibiotics, saline and wound film in Cooperative packaging with the labels scraped off. Enough for a small station for a year.

items.title: Evidence for the tribunal
items.text: A sealed evidence case for a Receivers tribunal, due to sit when the deadline runs out. A case that arrives after the verdict is not evidence.
items.note: Margo recognises the case number. She does not say where from.

cargo.label: Evidence case 4471 · Receivers seal
cargo.contents: A data core and a bundle of paper statements. The top statement is signed by somebody who worked on this ship.

items.title: A captain's share, owed
items.text: A dead captain's share of a prize, in a locked case, for her crew at the drop. Under the code, a share paid late is a share stolen.
items.note: There are people who think the share should have been theirs. Some of them know your name now.

cargo.label: Locked case · Free Berth seal
cargo.contents: Credit chits, a ring, and a list of eleven names with a sum beside each one.

items.title: The pilgrim ship Hollow Psalm
items.contact: The Quiet Order, through the brothers at Vigil
items.text: A pilgrim ship of the Order went dark in the Reach a generation ago. Bring back what can be brought back. Leave the passengers where they are.
items.note: The Order asks you to keep the lights low aboard her. They do not say why.

cargo.label: Hollow Psalm salvage
cargo.contents: Prayer slates, a lamp of old brass, and a ship's bell wrapped in a written cloth.

items.title: A company relay in the weather
items.text: A company relay buoy sits in a hazard on the chart, full of logs the Receivers want back. Cut out its memory cores and bring them in.
items.note: The buoy is still transmitting. Nobody at Registry Nine will say what.

cargo.label: Relay memory core
cargo.contents: A company memory core in a cracked housing, still warm, still recording.
